diagnosis.overview: The agent lacks reliable tools for extracting real data from web pages, PDFs, and images, leading to pervasive retrieval failures, synthetic placeholders (e.g., 'Sample Shopping Center #1' for live listings), misread CBA rates ($251.06 vs $252.06), and omissions like pill imprint 'NA' and missing MedlinePlus links.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacks reliable tools for extracting real data from web pages, PDFs, and images, leading to pervasive retrieval failures, synthetic placeholders (e.g., 'Sample Shopping Center #1' for live listings), misread CBA rates ($251.06 vs $252.06), and omissions like pill imprint 'NA' and missing MedlinePlus links.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Add a headless browser tool (e.g., Playwright) to access live CRE platforms and retrieve real listings; 2) Add an OCR/image-reading tool (e.g., Tesseract) to extract text and imprints from medication images; 3) Add a robust PDF parser and form-filling tool to handle tax forms, reference layouts, and bank statements; 4) Enforce a prompt rule that prohibits synthetic/placeholder data and requires verification of every extracted figure against the source before writing.
